fullPassage: It may be assumed that meta-algorithmics, that is, the creation of algorithms that generate other algorithms, is a human creation as well. A human programmer must have composed the first algorithm that, in turn, generates new algorithms and as such the initial programmer must be in control of the original idea. However, this is not necessarily true. Unlike humanly conceived ideas, where the author is the intellectual owner of the idea, algorithms are processes that define, describe, and implement a series of actions that in turn produce other actions. During the transfer of actions it is possible for a discrepancy to occur between the original intention and the actual result. If that happens then, by definition, the author of the algorithm is not in control of, and therefore does not own intellectually from that point on, the resulting process. Theoretically, ownership of an idea is intrinsically connected to the predictability of its outcome, that is, to its intellectual control. Therefore, in the absence of human control the ownership of the algorithmic process must be instead credited to the device that produced it, that is, to the computer.

questions.passage: It may be assumed that meta-algorithmics, that is, the creation of algorithms that generate other algorithms, is a human creation as well. A human programmer must have composed the first algorithm that, in turn, generates new algorithms and as such the initial programmer must be in control of the original idea. However, this is not necessarily true. Unlike humanly conceived ideas, where the author is the intellectual owner of the idea, algorithms are processes that define, describe, and implement a series of actions that in turn produce other actions. During the transfer of actions it is possible for a discrepancy to occur between the original intention and the actual result. If that happens then, by definition, the author of the algorithm is not in control of, and therefore does not own intellectually from that point on, the resulting process. Theoretically, ownership of an idea is intrinsically connected to the predictability of its outcome, that is, to its intellectual control. Therefore, in the absence of human control the ownership of the algorithmic process must be instead <u>credited</u> to the device that produced it, that is, to the computer.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 credited와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: credited=귀속되다/인정되다 → attributed=귀속되다/~의 것으로 돌리다
det.analysis:
❌ ① transferred: transferred(이전되다)는 소유권의 물리적 이동이지 공로 귀속의 의미와 다름
❌ ② withheld: withheld(보류되다)는 귀속의 반대로 주지 않음을 의미
✅ ③ attributed: attributed(귀속되다)는 credited(귀속되다/인정되다)의 동의어 ←정답
❌ ④ concealed: concealed(숨기다)는 귀속이 아닌 은닉을 의미
det.tip: credited = attributed = 귀속되다, ~의 공로로 돌리다

det.korean: intrinsically=본질적으로 → superficially=피상적으로/표면적으로
det.analysis:

questions.passage:
(A) The students took <u>control</u> of the classroom decorations, deciding on the theme and colors themselves.
(B) Theoretically, ownership of an idea is intrinsically connected to the predictability of its outcome, that is, to its intellectual <u>control</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 control의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: control: (A) 학생들이 교실 장식의 주도권을 잡았다 / (B) 지적 지배력(결과를 예측하고 관리하는 능력)
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 통제권 — (B) 통제권: 둘 다 같은 의미로 해석하면 (B)의 'intellectual control'이 '지적 통제권'이라는 추상적 지배력 의미를 놓침
✅ ② (A) 주도권 — (B) 지적 지배력: (A)는 장식을 스스로 결정하는 주도권, (B)는 결과 예측과 연결된 추상적 지적 지배력 ←정답
❌ ③ (A) 규제 — (B) 감시: 학생이 장식을 규제한다는 것은 부적절, (B)도 감시가 아닌 지배력
❌ ④ (A) 조정 — (B) 제한: 학생이 장식을 조정하는 것도 부적절, (B)는 제한이 아닌 지배력
det.tip: control: (1) (실질적) 주도권 (2) (추상적) 지적 지배력 — 원문에서 intellectual control은 아이디어 결과의 예측 가능성과 연결된 추상적 지배력

❌ ① algorithm: algorithm(알고리즘)은 절차/과정을 의미하여 불일치와 무관
❌ ② intention: intention(의도)은 목적을 의미하여 차이/불일치와 다름
✅ ③ discrepancy: discrepancy(불일치)는 같아야 할 두 것 사이의 차이로 영영 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ outcome: outcome(결과)은 결과물을 의미하여 차이/불일치와 다름
det.tip: discrepancy = 불일치, 차이. the original intention and the actual result 사이의 discrepancy
